text:
Hey! I have a question.

I have an appointment to renew my A5 visa on 25/01, but by mistake we booked flights to my home country for the next day. 😅

My Teudat Zehut is valid until 09/02/2027. Will this be a problem, or should I be okay to travel?

Has anyone been in a similar situation or knows what I should do? Any advice would be appreciated!
